verdict.rationale: Restate can be operated yourself as a single self-contained binary on your local machine, a VM, or Kubernetes. It also offers BYOC, which runs a managed Restate region in your own cloud account. Both options let you decide where the durable journal and state physically live, and your service code always runs in your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency documentation, region selection for the hosted Restate Cloud, and independent corroboration of residency controls.
